# laggar

Code for creating matrices of environmental variables at varying lags,
to enable scalar-on-function regression within the mgcv pacakge. The
statistical method follows the method of Miller et al
([2025](https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2508.07915)).

To install the package, use the following code:

    # install.packages("remotes")
    remotes::install_github("NERC-CEH/jsdmstan")

# Package index

## All functions

- [`doughnut_builder()`](https://nerc-ceh.github.io/laggar/reference/doughnut_builder.md)
  : Build doughnut geometries from a list of sf data frames
- [`doughnut_checker()`](https://nerc-ceh.github.io/laggar/reference/doughnut_checker.md)
  : Plot all the buffered polygons and a single object
- [`laggar-package`](https://nerc-ceh.github.io/laggar/reference/laggar-package.md)
  [`laggar`](https://nerc-ceh.github.io/laggar/reference/laggar-package.md)
  : The 'laggar' package.
- [`lg_assembly()`](https://nerc-ceh.github.io/laggar/reference/lg_assembly.md)
  : Assembling
- [`lg_plot()`](https://nerc-ceh.github.io/laggar/reference/lg_plot.md)
  : Visualise scalar-on-function regression data
- [`lg_points()`](https://nerc-ceh.github.io/laggar/reference/lg_points.md)
  : Get number of points within varying distances
- [`lg_rast()`](https://nerc-ceh.github.io/laggar/reference/lg_rast.md)
  : Summarize raster within incremental buffer zones around points
- [`sum_within_dist()`](https://nerc-ceh.github.io/laggar/reference/sum_within_dist.md)
  : Sum number of points within distance and polygon
- [`values_within_dist_rast()`](https://nerc-ceh.github.io/laggar/reference/values_within_dist_rast.md)
  : Extract raster values or summaries within concentric buffers
  ("doughnuts")
